name: qesis-mcp
comment: Python is the canonical runtime; see requirements.txt. This manifest exists only for the one remaining Node function, api/pack/download.ts, which needs jszip. There is deliberately no `build` script: declaring one made Vercel run `next build` against a repository that has no app/, pages/ or src/ directory, which failed every deployment from 9b9d0bb onward. Zero-config detection builds the Python and Node functions correctly on its own.
